raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Add the MI325X AgentX preset for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash from [InferenceX #4617](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4617). The existing recipe describes MI325X serving but does not expose this lane's TP8, TP4 and TP2 operating points in the builder.

## Claims

- Add 18 opt-in points, with concurrency 1/2/4/8/16/32 for each topology, scoped to the measured 0909 checkpoint.
- Generate the pinned image and production settings, including TP4 monokernel, topology-specific Engram placement and TP2 scheduler/graph budgets.
- Preserve real speculative verification in serving commands; document the separate AgentX throughput controls and evaluation scope.

## Validation

Revalidated after the maintainer main sync at head `ca1e5d401434`, using `vllm-project/recipes@9894c645e61a65c7a246aa565e864c1c660e92e2`:

```bash
# From the renderer checkout; VLLM_RECIPE_CHECKOUT is this source checkout.
node scripts/validate-source.mjs --source vllm --dir "$VLLM_RECIPE_CHECKOUT/recipes"

# From a vLLM checkout with its development environment.
.venv/bin/pre-commit run --files recipes/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.yaml
git diff --check origin/main...HEAD
```

The official source validator and applicable changed-file pre-commit hooks pass. All 18 MI325X points retain the previously checked argv, environment, image and Docker argv. The MI325X preset is unchanged; all seven current-main presets, including the separate MI355X TP8 addition, and other recipe fields are preserved. Comparisons cover 70 existing preset/variant renderings and 40 relevant default/Baseline renderings. Independent AI golden-review found no actionable recipe issue; this is separate from GitHub's human approvals.

An additional whole-catalog `node --test scripts/test-render-parity.mjs` run passed all 9,338 selectable per-hardware renderings and 222/223 preset points. Its sole mismatch, Mistral Large 4 `h200_dcp8`, also reproduces using the unmodified main recipe: its default NVFP4/H200 selection falls back in the query resolver. It is unrelated to this change; all 18 authored points pass.

Original validation with renderer `f628cde4a8a32446a2af9486e0838afd31d8efd0` included 47 renderer tests, 136 existing preset renderings, 1,616 baseline renderings, and browser checks for all 18 Docker commands, the preset API, representative Verify/Bench clients for each topology, the runbook, feature toggles and Baseline. That browser evidence is reused after configuration/output preservation checks; no new browser or GPU execution is claimed.

Existing GPU evidence was inspected; no new GPU execution is claimed:

| Evidence | Configuration | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Run 40744174186](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40744174186), `7c375027a3cd` | 18 AgentX performance points; TP8 c32 real-verification GSM8K | All points passed; GSM8K 97.42% strict exact match, 1,319 samples |
| [Run 40718348873](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40718348873), `3df335bfe629` | TP4 c4 real-verification GSM8K, mono execution confirmed in logs | 97.42% strict exact match, 1,319 samples |

The effective lane configuration was rechecked and remains unchanged at InferenceX head `6e1386c0212a5d07629a9309d3a2e9bf5563cc14`; measured provenance remains the run-specific revisions above. Accuracy was not separately evaluated at every concurrency or on the 1017 checkpoint. This recipe-only change makes no new performance claim.

## Details

This follows the structured preset approach in [#63560](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63560). Searches of open and merged recipe work found no MI325X AgentX preset for #4617; the merged generic MI325X update [#62713](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/62713) and the existing presets do not cover these operating points.

The preset stays opt-in and uses existing synthesis support. TP8/TP2 explicitly remove the inherited monokernel flag; TP4 retains it. Synthetic acceptance length is only documented as an InferenceX throughput control, while generated serving and accuracy commands keep real block verification. The runbook discloses the pinned TP4 draft FFN activation behavior and the unresolved InferenceX qualification question; documenting the configuration does not resolve that separate review.

AI assistance was used to prepare the recipe, inspect upstream evidence and validate generated output.

---

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.

- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.

</details>

@@ -892,6 +892,213 @@ presets:
       plus `--request-timeout-secs 14400` so long agentic requests outlive the 1800 s default
       and `--disable-retries` so a failed request is not replayed.
 
+  mi325x_agentx:
+    label: "AgentX TP8 / TP4 / TP2"
+    hardware: mi325x
+    strategy: single_node_tp
+    variants: [fp8]
+    workload: "Agentic (InferenceX AgentX)"
+    description: "TP8 with resident Engram tables, TP4 with monokernel and host Engram, and TP2 with host Engram and smaller scheduler and graph budgets; six concurrency points per topology."
+    source: { label: "InferenceX #4617", href: "https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4617", key: "dsv41flash-fp4-mi325x-vllm-agentic-dspark", revision: 7c375027a3cd50f63153222fa6eb7069ee86d3b4 }
+    image: "vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-rocm100-edad8b03c5285a1c12e7e4f83c1af709b319a01b@sha256:009169c114af5b15e25eddc808afb3c1fc3f12c94e746472b16f39fcf39cd716"
+    select:
+      frontend: rust
+      features: { tool_calling: true, reasoning: true, spec_decoding: true, text_only: true, encoder_parallel: false }
+      dcp: 1
+      kv_offload: off
+    args:
+      - "--served-model-name"
+      - "deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash"
+      - "--max-model-len"
+      - "1048576"
+      - "--max-num-seqs"
+      - "128"
+      - "--max-num-batched-tokens"
+      - "16384"
+      - "--max-cudagraph-capture-size"
+      - "1024"
+      - "--disable-uvicorn-access-log"
+      - "--monokernel"
+    env:
+      OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"
+      PYTHONUNBUFFERED: "1"
+    json_args:
+      "--speculative-config":
+        num_speculative_tokens: 5
+        draft_sample_method: probabilistic
+        rejection_sample_method: block
+        enable_adaptive_verification: false
+      "--compilation-config": { cudagraph_mode: FULL_DECODE_ONLY }
+    points:
+      tp8_c1:
+        label: "1 (TP8)"
+        concurrency: 1
+        tp: 8
+        remove_args: ["--monokernel"]
+        json_args:
+          "--engram-config": { cpu_offload: false }
+      tp8_c2:
+        label: "2 (TP8)"
+        concurrency: 2
+        tp: 8
+        remove_args: ["--monokernel"]
+        json_args:
+          "--engram-config": { cpu_offload: false }
+      tp8_c4:
+        label: "4 (TP8)"
+        concurrency: 4
+        tp: 8
+        remove_args: ["--monokernel"]
+        json_args:
+          "--engram-config": { cpu_offload: false }
+      tp8_c8:
+        label: "8 (TP8)"
+        concurrency: 8
+        tp: 8
+        remove_args: ["--monokernel"]
+        json_args:
+          "--engram-config": { cpu_offload: false }
+      tp8_c16:
+        label: "16 (TP8)"
+        concurrency: 16
+        tp: 8
+        remove_args: ["--monokernel"]
+        json_args:
+          "--engram-config": { cpu_offload: false }
+      tp8_c32:
+        label: "32 (TP8)"
+        concurrency: 32
+        tp: 8
+        remove_args: ["--monokernel"]
+        json_args:
+          "--engram-config": { cpu_offload: false }
+      tp4_c1:
+        label: "1 (TP4)"
+        concurrency: 1
+        tp: 4
+      tp4_c2:
+        label: "2 (TP4)"
+        concurrency: 2
+        tp: 4
+      tp4_c4:
+        label: "4 (TP4)"
+        concurrency: 4
+        default: true
+        tp: 4
+      tp4_c8:
+        label: "8 (TP4)"
+        concurrency: 8
+        tp: 4
+      tp4_c16:
+        label: "16 (TP4)"
+        concurrency: 16
+        tp: 4
+      tp4_c32:
+        label: "32 (TP4)"
+        concurrency: 32
+        tp: 4
+      tp2_c1:
+        label: "1 (TP2)"
+        concurrency: 1
+        tp: 2
+        remove_args: ["--monokernel"]
+        args:
+          - "--max-num-seqs"
+          - "16"
+          - "--max-num-batched-tokens"
+          - "8192"
+          - "--max-cudagraph-capture-size"
+          - "512"
+      tp2_c2:
+        label: "2 (TP2)"
+        concurrency: 2
+        tp: 2
+        remove_args: ["--monokernel"]
+        args:
+          - "--max-num-seqs"
+          - "16"
+          - "--max-num-batched-tokens"
+          - "8192"
+          - "--max-cudagraph-capture-size"
+          - "512"
+      tp2_c4:
+        label: "4 (TP2)"
+        concurrency: 4
+        tp: 2
+        remove_args: ["--monokernel"]
+        args:
+          - "--max-num-seqs"
+          - "16"
+          - "--max-num-batched-tokens"
+          - "8192"
+          - "--max-cudagraph-capture-size"
+          - "512"
+      tp2_c8:
+        label: "8 (TP2)"
+        concurrency: 8
+        tp: 2
+        remove_args: ["--monokernel"]
+        args:
+          - "--max-num-seqs"
+          - "16"
+          - "--max-num-batched-tokens"
+          - "8192"
+          - "--max-cudagraph-capture-size"
+          - "512"
+      tp2_c16:
+        label: "16 (TP2)"
+        concurrency: 16
+        tp: 2
+        remove_args: ["--monokernel"]
+        args:
+          - "--max-num-seqs"
+          - "32"
+          - "--max-num-batched-tokens"
+          - "8192"
+          - "--max-cudagraph-capture-size"
+          - "512"
+      tp2_c32:
+        label: "32 (TP2)"
+        concurrency: 32
+        tp: 2
+        remove_args: ["--monokernel"]
+        args:
+          - "--max-num-seqs"
+          - "64"
+          - "--max-num-batched-tokens"
+          - "8192"
+          - "--max-cudagraph-capture-size"
+          - "512"
+    runbook: |
+      These points serve the 0909 launch checkpoint with five-token DSpark and
+      real block verification. TP8 keeps Engram in HBM; TP4 and TP2 offload it
+      to host memory. TP2 uses smaller scheduler, prefill and graph budgets.
+      Decode uses full graphs, prefill runs eagerly, and decoder SWA bounded
+      replay keeps the pinned image's enabled default.
+
+      The TP4 monokernel runs eligible decode steps of at most 42 rows, then
+      falls back to the ordinary path for larger steps. On this image it also
+      quantizes DSpark draft FFN inputs from BF16 to MXFP8. The profile records
+      the measured configuration; its [InferenceX draft-precision qualification](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#draft-model-precision)
+      remains unresolved. TP8 and TP2 use the ordinary FFN path. Adaptive
+      verification remains disabled for the gfx942 startup issue tracked in
+      [vLLM #63816](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63816).
+
+      [Run 40744174186](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40744174186)
+      passed all 18 performance points and the TP8 c32 GSM8K evaluation at
+      `7c375027a3cd`. The separate [TP4 c4 evaluation](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40718348873)
+      at `3df335bfe629` confirmed active mono execution. Both GSM8K evaluations
+      scored 97.42% strict exact match over 1,319 samples. The effective serving
+      configuration is unchanged at reviewed source head `c8befe0ed1f0`.
+
+      InferenceX throughput measurement separately substitutes synthetic
+      acceptance length 3.51 from its committed DSpark thinking-on curve.
+      This control is excluded from the preset's serving and accuracy commands;
+      the generic Bench action is not an AgentX trace replay. Concurrency labels
+      identify the measured workload, while the generated sequence cap controls
+      admission and may queue additional sessions. No independent accuracy
+      evaluation was performed at every concurrency or on the 1017 checkpoint.
+
   mi355x_agentx:
     label: "AgentX TP2"
     hardware: mi355x
